Bakerloo.reason: Bakerloo Line: Severe delays between Stonebridge Park and Harrow & Wealdstone due to a sewage leak on the track at Watford High Street. Tickets being accepted on London Buses. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Central.reason: Central Line: Minor delays between North Acton and Ealing Broadway / West Ruislip and between Leytonstone and Epping / Hainault due to train cancellations. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Elizabeth line.reason: Minor delays between Paddington and Heathrow Terminal 4 due to vandalism to railway equipment in the Paddington area. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Lioness.reason: Lioness Line: No service between Harrow & Wealdstone and Watford Junction and SEVERE DELAYS on the rest of the line due to a sewage leak on the track at Watford High Street. London Underground is accepting tickets via reasonable routes, but Bakerloo line services are also disrupted.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: No service between Baker Street and Aldgate and MINOR DELAYS between Harrow-on-the-Hill and Uxbridge due to a collapsed drain on the track at Baker Street. SEVERE DELAYS Harrow-on-the-Hill and Baker Street due to an earlier faulty train at Finchley Road. Tickets being accepted on London Buses and Chiltern railway services. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Northern.reason: Northern Line: Severe delays between Camden Town and Edgware due to an earlier signal failure at Chalk Farm. MINOR DELAYS on the rest of line. Tickets are being accepted on London Buses and Thameslink.

Piccadilly.reason: Piccadilly Line: Minor delays due to an earlier customer incident at Hounslow East.
